notes.title: SPOOKWARE Embarks on the 'Big Adventure Event'!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings folks![/h3]
[url=https://hitcents.com/]Hitcents[/url] is hosting the exciting [b]'Big Adventure Event'[/b] on Steam from [i][u]January 20th-24th, 2022[/u][/i]. It's a grand celebration of titles that focus on escapades, zany exploits, and well, adventures! There'll be many games coming along for the ride, showcasing their stuff through broadcasts, sales, demos, and more!

How could the brothers say no to an opportunity like that? Be sure to pick up [i][b]SPOOKWARE[/b][/i] during the event! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574250/SPOOKWARE/

And as always, if you want to keep up with the comings, goings, and haunts happening at [b]DreadXP[/b], follow us on our socials!
